title: Cancellation Reasons and the Appointment Series Late-Cancellation Fee — Questions Answered
content:
Training questions on the reason share in the late-cancellation fee of an Appointment Series.

**The rule.** The late-cancellation reason share is 50 percent where the reason recorded on the cancellation is patient illness or family emergency, 80 percent where it is transportation or weather, and 100 percent for any other reason. The share is read as a percentage of the late-cancellation basis and multiplies it.

**Which cancellation's reason is used?** The reason recorded on the most recent cancellation on the series that carries no minutes late, the one with the latest appointment date.

**Does the reason the patient gives on the call change the share?** The share follows the reason recorded on the cancellation entry.

**What share does a cancellation recorded for transportation carry?** 80 percent, the same as one recorded for weather.

**And one recorded for any reason outside those four?** 100 percent.

| Reason recorded on the cancellation | Reason share |
|---|---|
| patient illness | 50 percent |
| family emergency | 50 percent |
| transportation | 80 percent |
| weather | 80 percent |
| any other reason | 100 percent |

**Example (hypothetical figures).** A late-cancellation basis of USD 25.00 with the reason recorded as weather: 80 percent of USD 25.00 is USD 20.00.
